namespace = eir

# Eire Reborn - raid relay events. Generated by tools/gen_script_raid.py

# 1200: a raid action has finished (root = the raid army). Picks a story for a Gaelic or Brythonic raider, and one for a Gaelic or Brythonic victim.
eir.1200 = {
	hidden = yes
	scope = army

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = eir_raid_army
		scope:raider = { save_scope_as = eir_raider }
		scope:barony = { save_scope_as = eir_barony }
		scope:county = { save_scope_as = eir_county }
		scope:barony.holder ?= { save_scope_as = eir_victim }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eir_raider = {
					is_ai = no
					eir_raid_celt_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = 60
				scope:eir_raider = {
					random_list = {
				12 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1201
				}
				12 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1202
				}
				8 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1203
				}
				8 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0
						NOT = { exists = scope:eir_victim }
					}
					trigger_event = eir.1204
				}
				10 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0
						scope:eir_county.culture = scope:eir_raider.culture
						scope:eir_county.faith = scope:eir_raider.faith
					}
					trigger_event = eir.1205
				}
				7 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0
						NOT = { scope:eir_barony.title_province = { has_holding_type = church_holding } }
					}
					trigger_event = eir.1206
				}
				8 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1207
				}
				8 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1208
				}
				7 = {
					modifier = {
						factor = 0
						NOT = { exists = scope:eir_victim }
					}
					trigger_event = eir.1209
				}
				7 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1210
				}
				6 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1211
				}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:eir_victim
				scope:eir_victim = {
					is_ai = no
					eir_raid_celt_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = 60
				scope:eir_victim = {
					random_list = {
				14 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1212
				}
				12 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1213
				}
				10 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1214
				}
				10 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1215
				}
				8 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1216
				}
				8 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1217
				}
				8 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1218
				}
				8 = {
					trigger_event = eir.1219
				}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# 1230: the raider has come home with the loot (root = the raid army)
eir.1230 = {
	hidden = yes
	scope = army

	immediate = {
		scope:raider = { save_scope_as = eir_raider }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eir_raider = {
					is_ai = no
					eir_raid_celt_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = 45
				scope:eir_raider = {
					random_list = {
						10 = { trigger_event = eir.1220 }
						10 = { trigger_event = eir.1221 }
						8 = { trigger_event = eir.1222 }
						8 = { trigger_event = eir.1223 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# 1231: a raid army has been beaten in battle (root = the raid army)
eir.1231 = {
	hidden = yes
	scope = army

	immediate = {
		scope:raider = { save_scope_as = eir_raider }
		scope:receiver ?= { save_scope_as = eir_victim }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eir_raider = {
					is_ai = no
					eir_raid_celt_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			scope:eir_raider = { trigger_event = eir.1224 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:eir_victim
				scope:eir_victim = {
					is_ai = no
					eir_raid_celt_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			scope:eir_victim = { trigger_event = eir.1225 }
		}
	}
}
